title: TodoMVC 100-item controlled journey
description: A framework-free controlled pair owns the same 100-item state machine and emits typed commands that a minimal host adapter applies to the real DOM.

inputs.generation: 100 repository-owned multilingual labels and a 150-action trace: 100 add, 34 complete, 3 filter, 10 remove, and 3 edit actions

oracle.policy: Exact typed-command stream, engine state, final physical DOM, accessibility names/states, focus target, and UTF-16 selection range.
oracle.deadCodeDefense: Every command is physically applied to the DOM; final state and command bytes are hashed and compared with the supplemental oracle.

work.tolerance: All semantic, command, physical-DOM, accessibility, focus, selection, and work counters must match exactly; target-specific allocation and boundary counters remain explicit.
